answer: Every account must launch a ripple: a short live answer to a prompt issued minutes earlier, so scripts cannot prepare it in advance. The ripple travels only when a stranger who never met the sender endorses it at a public jetty, a meeting point that expires within the hour. The summit needs five such endorsements from five different clusters. A Sybil farm can mint thousands of accounts, but its ripples never leave its own pond: no outsider endorses one they never received, and the jetty closes before the farm herds its sockpuppets through. Honest users just answer one fresh prompt.
